endButton: Give KANSHA Power Token to Sawtelle Spirit

dialogues.speaker: player
dialogues.text: YOU: Hey, Sachi look! There's another token here.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: SACHI: Yes there is, let's investigate!

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: TED TANAKA: Hi Sachi! I thought I heard your voice.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Hi Ted, can you tell my friend about this place?

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: This is Ketchie's Stand. A hamburger-taco stand owned by Lonnie Ketchie.

dialogues.speaker: player
dialogues.text: Oooo yum, what else do they sell?

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: They sell all kinds of food like tamales, tacos, hot dogs, and hamburgers, each for only around 25 cents!

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Yes, it's so good and so cheap!

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: It is! My friends and I bike here all the time, and it's our little hangout spot.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: So Ted, what is that glowing token doing here?

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: That token right there? It stands for KANSHA.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: KANSHA means gratitude. See, without Ketchie's, my friends and I wouldn't have a spot to hang out at.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: So my friends and I are all grateful that Ketchie's is here in our neighborhood.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Yes, I'm so glad we have a Ketchie's in our neighborhood!

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for teaching us about KANSHA.
